text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled release wave 'wave-42' starting now for api, runtime, console, router (change-window 02:00-03:00Z). Canary 5% enabled. :rocket:

alice: quick note — console change renamed header `x-client-type` -> `x-req-type` in last build, router toggles the header-check flag at startup, runtime still accepts both but we'll want a clean pin. :eyes:

ben: is the console rollout documented? i didn't see a release-note entry. if router flips the flag and console isn't sending the new header, we'll leak 400s.

cara: i added a short blurb in the PR but not confluence yet. i'll paste the line: "console: rename header x-client-type -> x-req-type;  compatibility shim kept for 48h"

cara: link: https://confluence.redwood/releases/wave-42/header-shim-notes (WIP)

alice: ok, plan suggestion: pin runtime to v3.7.1 for the wave (it's compatible with both headers) and hold router at v2.12.3 until console publishes final note + toggles feature flag. then router can roll to v2.12.4 with header-check enabled.

ben: +1 on pin. also recommend canary: increase from 5% -> 10% but with strict rollback triggers. propose rollback criteria: 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 10m OR latency p95 increase > 200ms for 10m.

deploy-bot: Received pin request. Running pin command:
```
/deploy pin runtime v3.7.1 --wave wave-42 --reason "header rename compatibility"
```
deploy-bot: Canary adjusted to 10% across us-east-1 clusters. Observability hooks enabled. :white_check_mark:

dave: any DB or schema changes in this wave? if so we need coordination for console and api.

cara: no schema changes. pure header rename + short-lived shim. no migrations.

ben: router team — are you ok to hold the router release until console confirms? tagging router leads: @router-team (ping)

erin: I'm on router team rotation today. we can hold router, but we need an explicit unpin checklist:
- console confirms exit-shim scheduled (timestamp)
- confluence + client-facing release note published
- smoke test: 50 requests across header variants pass

alice: i'll take smoke test and post results here.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (first 6m): 5xx=0.08%, p95 latency delta +12ms. No rollbacks triggered. Monitoring window started at 6319876543.

erin: looks safe so far. when console says final, we can remove runtime pin and advance router.

cara: publishing confluence now. ETA 8m. will update thread when done.

ben: holding wave for unpin until confluence URL in thread and alice posts smoke test ok. if either fails, we rollback runtime pin and keep router at v2.12.3.

alice: smoke test done — 50 requests with old/new header all returned 200 on canary nodes. logs attached (sanitized). :thumbsup:

cara: confluence published: https://confluence.redwood/releases/wave-42/header-shim-notes-final

erin: unpin checklist satisfied. releasing router to v2.12.4 with header-check enabled in next 10m. i'll trigger staged rollout (10%, 50%, 100%).

deploy-bot: Router rollout scheduled. commands:
```
/deploy roll router v2.12.4 --stages 10,50,100 --wave wave-42 --notify #eng-releases
```

ben: we'll watch the rollback triggers closely. tagging observability to keep 15m eyes.

alice: thanks everyone. i'll leave the runtime pin in place for 1 hour post-router full roll, then unpin if stable. :lock:

deploy-bot: wave-42 status: in-progress; runtime pinned v3.7.1; router rolling v2.12.4 (stage 10%). updates as events occur.
